title: Payment received confirmation
description: Confirm a received payment on WhatsApp with amount, date and receipt number. A utility template for banks, lenders and fintechs.
notes: Include a receipt or transaction ID as a variable; it makes the message clearly transactional and helps customers file support requests.

body.text: Hello {{first_name}}, we received your payment of *{{amount}}* on {{date}}. Your receipt number is *{{receipt_id}}*. Thank you for staying up to date.
